System total bonds payable at 8/31/2024: par $9,552,880,000 (PUF $2,912,555,000; RFS $6,475,475,000; RFS-Stephen F. Austin $164,850,000) per Note 13; this is the SYSTEM total and must not be used for the campus. Prior-year (8/31/2023) Notes, Loans, and Leases Payable were 6,749,282.68 + 27,781,241.33. Confidence is medium because the campus share of system bonds is not disclosed and the on-books caption could not be split into notes / leases / SBITA. IPEDS $0 is consistent with IPEDS Part L wording ('debt issued in the name of the institution') but does not mean UTSA has no debt-financed facilities.

Confidence is medium because all figures are unaudited and the campus share of system bonds is not disclosed. Tarleton's own statement of net position carries no long-term debt, yet it transferred $37,909,398.00 to the System in FY2024 as mandatory intrasystem transfers for capital debt (debt service on system-held debt; context only, not a balance).
